changelog.p.002: Ingxelo emfutshane yoguqulelo ngalunye lwePickVia olukhutshwe esidlangalaleni. Khuphela uguqulelo lwamva nje kwiGitHub.
changelog.p.003: Khetha izikhangeli neentlelo ezingakumbi, iiprofayile zeFirefox zihlelwe ngohlelo ezinxulumene nalo.
changelog.li.001: Kongezwe iChrome Dev neCanary; Edge Beta, Dev, neCanary; Brave Beta neNightly; Vivaldi Snapshot; neFirefox Developer Edition neNightly njengezikhangeli ezikhethwa ngokwahlukeneyo.
changelog.li.002: Kongezwe ukuvula okuqhelekileyo kwinqanaba le-app kwiOpera, Arc, Orion, neSafari Technology Preview.
changelog.li.003: Iiprofayile zeFirefox zigcinwa kuhlelo lwazo olubhaliweyo xa lunokuchongwa, kwaye izinto eziphindiweyo ezazifunyenwe kudala ziyasuswa xa kukhangelwa kwakhona. Iiprofayile ezingenamethadatha yonxulumano ethembekileyo zigcina indlela ekhoyo yokusebenzisa ukhetho olungelolokuqala.
changelog.li.004: Kulungiswe iindlela zeefolda zeeprofayile zeFirefox ezazikhatywa emva kokulungiswa kweendlela zethutyana yi-macOS.
changelog.li.005: Kuboniswa kuphela indibaniselwano yokuvula exhaswayo. Iifestile zabucala zihlala zilukhetho lwenqanaba lesikhangeli; indlela yabucala yeprofayile ethile ayifumaneki.
changelog.p.004: IDuckDuckGo iyafumaneka ngoku njengokhetho lwesikhangeli, inokhetho lwabucala kwiinguqulelo ezisemthethweni ezixhaswayo.
changelog.li.006: Khetha iDuckDuckGo eqhelekileyo okanye yabucala kwifestile enye yokukhetha.
changelog.li.007: Indlela yabucala isebenzisa idatha ezimeleyo esuswayo emva kokusetyenziswa, ayifuni songezo okanye imvume yokuFikeleleka, kwaye iphelele kwiinguqulelo ezisemthethweni ezixhaswayo ezikhutshelwa ngqo.
changelog.p.005: IGoogle Chrome Beta ngoku lukhetho lwesikhangeli olwahlukileyo, lineeprofayile zalo nokhetho oluqhelekileyo okanye lwabucala.
changelog.p.006: Amakhonkco e-imeyile ngoku anokuvula kwi-app ye-imeyile efakiweyo oyikhethayo.
changelog.li.008: Khetha kwii-app ze-imeyile ezibhalisiweyo kwaye ulawule ulandelelwano lwazo kuSeto lwe-imeyile.
changelog.li.009: IPickVia ayibonisi kwangaphambili okanye igcine abamkeli, izihloko, imizimba yemiyalezo, okanye ikhonkco le-imeyile lokuqala.
changelog.p.007: Uguqulelo lokuqala lukawonke-wonke: khetha isikhangeli, iprofayile, okanye indlela yabucala exhaswayo kwikhonkco ngalinye lewebhu.
changelog.li.010: Ixhasa iSafari, Chrome, Chromium, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, neFirefox.
changelog.li.011: Faka ngeDMG ngokutsalela i-app kwifolda yeApplications.
changelog.span.002: Ekhaya · Ubumfihlo · Imiqathango · Ikhowudi yomthombo kwiGitHub ↗
changelog.description.001: Amanqaku eenguqulelo zePickVia, isikhethi samakhonkco esakhelwe i-macOS ngqo.
index.title.001: PickVia - Khetha isikhangeli okanye iprofayile efanelekileyo kwikhonkco ngalinye lewebhu
index.p.001: Ifumaneka ngeelwimi ezingama-80 kusetyenziso nakwiwebhusayithi, kunye neenguqulelo ze-README ezili-12. Khetha ulwimi lwakho kwiiSetingi.
index.p.003: IPickVia iyabuza ngaphambi kokuvula ikhonkco ngalinye lewebhu okanye le-imeyile, ukuze amakhonkco ewebhu aye kwisikhangeli okanye kwiprofayile oyikhethayo kwaye awe-imeyile aye kwi-app obufuna ukuyisebenzisa.
index.div.001: Khuphela v1.5 ↓★ Nika inkwenkwezi kwiGitHub
index.p.004: macOS 14+ · Apple Silicon · Isimahla kwaye ikhowudi ivulekile
index.p.007: Khetha indawo efanelekileyo kwikhonkco ngalinye lewebhu okanye le-imeyile.
index.p.008: Khetha isikhangeli okanye iprofayile evuliweyo, okanye ifestile yabucala exhaswayo kwinqanaba lesikhangeli.
index.p.009: Khetha i-app ye-imeyile ebhalisiweyo oyifunayo endaweni yokuthumela lonke ikhonkco le-mailto: kwi-app enye engagqibekanga.
index.p.010: Lungelelanisa izinto oqhele ukuzikhetha, uze usebenzise ukucofa kube kanye okanye indlela emfutshane yekhibhodi.
index.p.011: Khetha iintlelo ezahlukeneyo zeChrome neEdge, iBrave Beta okanye Nightly, iVivaldi Snapshot, neFirefox Developer Edition okanye Nightly. Iiprofayile zeFirefox ezinonxulumano olwaziwayo nohlelo zihlala kolo hlelo.
index.p.012: IOpera, Arc, Orion, neSafari Technology Preview zinokhetho lwesikhangeli oluqhelekileyo. Inkxaso yeeprofayile neefestile zabucala iyahluka ngesikhangeli. Jonga inkxaso yezikhangeli →
index.p.014: I-macOS idla ngokuthumela amakhonkco e-mailto: kwi-app enye engagqibekanga. IPickVia ikuvumela ukhethe kwii-app ze-imeyile ezibhalisiweyo kwiMac yakho ngalo lonke ixesha.
index.div.002: YENZELWE UBUMFIHLOIPickVia ithumela isicelo sokuqala ngqo kwinto oyikhethileyo. Ayibhali kwilog okanye igcine ngokusisigxina umxholo we-imeyile.
index.p.016: Misela iiprofayile zesikhangeli nee-app ze-imeyile oqhele ukuzisebenzisa kube kanye, uze ulungelelanise iindawo ozisebenzisa kakhulu.
index.span.002: Imbali yeenguqu · Ubumfihlo · Imiqathango · Ikhowudi yomthombo kwiGitHub ↗
index.description.001: IPickVia ikuvumela ukhethe isikhangeli okanye iprofayile kwikhonkco ngalinye lewebhu kunye ne-app ye-imeyile kwikhonkco ngalinye le-imeyile kwi-macOS.
index.alt.001: Ifestile yokukhetha isikhangeli yePickVia ebonisa iiprofayile zesikhangeli, iindawo zabucala, neendlela ezimfutshane zekhibhodi
index.alt.002: Ifestile yokukhetha i-imeyile yePickVia ebonisa ii-app ze-imeyile ezifakiweyo
index.alt.003: Useto lwezikhangeli lwePickVia olunezikhangeli nemizekelo yeeprofayile
privacy.p.003: IPickVia ayiqokeleli, ayithumeli, ayithengisi, okanye yabelane ngedatha yobuqu. I-app ayinazo iiakhawunti, uhlalutyo, iintengiso, okanye ukuqokelelwa kwemilinganiselo yokusetyenziswa.
privacy.li.001: Amakhonkco aphathwa kwisixhobo sakho aze adluliselwe ngqo kwisikhangeli okanye kwi-app ye-imeyile oyikhethayo.
privacy.li.002: IPickVia ayibhali kwilog okanye igcine ii-URL ezivuliweyo, abamkeli, izihloko, okanye imizimba yemiyalezo.
privacy.li.003: Useto lugcinwa kwisixhobo sakho kwifolda yeApplication Support.
privacy.li.004: Xa unika ufikelelo kwiiprofayile zesikhangeli, iPickVia igcina kwisixhobo sakho ibhukhimakhi enomda wokhuseleko kwaye ifunda kuphela imethadatha efunekayo ukuchonga iiprofayile. Ayifundi imbali yokukhangela, iikuki, iiseshoni, amagama ayimfihlo agciniweyo, okanye umxholo wamaphepha.
privacy.p.004: Iwebhusayithi yePickVia ayisebenzisi uhlalutyo, izilandeli zeentengiso, iifomu, okanye iikuki ezibekwe yiPickVia. Igcinwe kwiGitHub Pages. IGitHub ingaphatha iinkcukacha zobugcisa zezicelo ngokwe-Ngxelo yayo yobumfihlo.
privacy.p.005: Izikhangeli, ii-app ze-imeyile, iGitHub, nezinye iinkonzo ozikhetha ukuzivula okanye ukuzindwendwela zineendlela zazo zobumfihlo. IPickVia ayizilawuli ezo nkonzo.
privacy.p.006: Ukuba lo mgaqo-nkqubo uyatshintsha, uguqulelo oluhlaziyiweyo nomhla wokuqalisa ukusebenza ziya kupapashwa kweli phepha.
terms.p.003: IPickVia yi-app ye-macOS esimahla enekhowudi evulekileyo. Ungayisebenzisa, uyikope, uyiguqule, kwaye uyisasaze phantsi kweLayisenisi yeMIT equkwe kule projekthi.
terms.p.004: IPickVia ayifuni akhawunti, umrhumo, okanye ntlawulo. Ukhuphelo lunikezelwa kwiinguqulelo ezisemthethweni zeprojekthi kwiGitHub.
terms.p.005: Luxanduva lwakho ukugqiba ukuba uza kuyifaka uyisebenzise na iPickVia, ukukhetha ii-app ezifumana amakhonkco akho, ukugcina iMac yakho ikhuselekile, nokuthobela imithetho esebenzayo. Dlula ukhuseleko lwe-macOS Gatekeeper kuphela xa uluthemba uguqulelo olukhutshelweyo.
terms.p.006: IPickVia inikezelwa «njengoko injalo», ngaphandle kweziqinisekiso zalo naluphi na uhlobo. Ngokomda ovunyelwa ngumthetho, umphuhlisi akanaxanduva lomonakalo okanye ilahleko evela ekusebenziseni okanye ekungakwazini ukusebenzisa iPickVia.
terms.p.007: IPickVia ingavula izikhangeli, ii-app ze-imeyile, iiwebhusayithi, neenkonzo zamaqela angaphandle. Ezo mveliso zilawulwa yimiqathango yazo kwaye azilawulwa okanye zixhaswe yiPickVia.
terms.p.008: IPickVia ingahlaziywa, itshintshwe, okanye iyekiswe nangaliphi na ixesha. Le miqathango nayo ingahlaziywa, kuze kupapashwe apha uguqulelo olutsha nomhla wokuqalisa ukusebenza.
release.v1_5.title: Uguqulelo 1.5
release.v1_5.safari: Zama iiprofayile zovavanyo ze-Safari Stable ngeemvume zokufikeleleka nezokusebenza ngokuzenzekelayo. Ikhonkco ngalinye livuleka kwifestile entsha yeprofayile ekhethiweyo.
release.v1_5.duckduckgo: Ukubuyiselwa nokucocwa kweeseshoni zabucala ze-DuckDuckGo kwenziwe lula. Iinguqulelo ze-1.203.x ezihambelanayo nezingasebenzisi indawo evalelweyo zixhasa ukuvula ngasese; amakhonkco aqhelekileyo awafuni nguqulelo ithile okanye utyikityo lomshicileli.
release.v1_5.signing: Kusetyenziswa isatifikethi esinye esisisigxina se-Apple Development xa kusakhiwa usetyenziso. Into ekhutshelwayo ayinasiqinisekiso se-notarization; landela imiyalelo yokufaka ekwi-README.
